FX-NOISEHLS-001.says: The settings as they start: Uniform, Lightness 10: each shown pixel's lightness moves up to 0.1 either way, its own amount, keeping its hue and saturation and its covering; the empty pixels are left; the same on every frame.

FX-NOISEHLS-002.says: Hue 50, Lightness 0: each coloured pixel's hue turns up to 90 degrees either way, its lightness and saturation kept; the grey has no hue and is left.

FX-NOISEHLS-003.says: Saturation 50, Lightness 0: the saturation moves up to 0.5 either way, held in 0 and 1, so the full primaries only lose saturation and the grey only gains it.

FX-NOISEHLS-004.says: Lightness 100: the lightness moves up to 1 either way, held, so some pixels turn white or black.

FX-NOISEHLS-005.says: Hue, Lightness and Saturation 30 together, each with its own noise.

FX-NOISEHLS-006.says: Squared, Lightness 30: the noise pushed out towards its ends, so every pixel's lightness moves at least as far as in Uniform, the same way.

FX-NOISEHLS-007.says: Grain, Grain Size 1, Lightness 30: smooth noise in cells of a pixel.

FX-NOISEHLS-008.says: Grain, Grain Size 4, Lightness 30: the cells four pixels across, so neighbouring pixels move nearly together.

FX-NOISEHLS-009.says: Grain, Grain Size 2.5, Hue 40, Saturation 40, Lightness 0.

FX-NOISEHLS-010.says: Uniform at phase 180, Lightness 30: half way between the noise at depth 0 and at depth 1.

FX-NOISEHLS-011.says: Noise Phase keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 720 at frame 4, Lightness 30: a new noise each turn, reached smoothly; frame 1 is phase 180, FX-NOISEHLS-010's.

FX-NOISEHLS-012.says: Phase -90, Hue 100: the phase runs below 0 too, a quarter of the way back from depth 0 to depth -1.

FX-NOISEHLS-013.says: Hue, Lightness and Saturation 0: the drawing, untouched.

FX-NOISEHLS-014.says: FX-NOISEHLS-005 moved three pixels right: the noise is the drawing's own, so it moves with it.

FX-NOISEHLS-015.says: After a Motion Tile that grows the layer: the noise is worked in the drawing's own pixels, so the frame is FX-NOISEHLS-005's.

FX-NOISEHLS-016.says: Lightness keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 40 at frame 4: frame 0 is the drawing.

FX-NOISEHLS-017.says: Grain, Grain Size 0.5, Lightness 30: cells of half a pixel.

FX-NOISEHLS-018.says: Grain, Grain Size 3, Hue 20, Lightness 25, Saturation 60, phase keyed 0 to 500: the controls together.

FX-NOISEHLS-019.says: Hue 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-NOISEHLS-020.says: Lightness -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-NOISEHLS-021.says: Saturation 150, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-NOISEHLS-022.says: Grain Size 0.25, below 0.5. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-NOISEHLS-023.says: Noise Phase 200000, above 100000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-NOISEHLS-024.says: Noise "Uniform", in capitals, kept as written and not the word. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-NOISEHLS-025.says: Noise "grainy", not one of its three words. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-NOISEHLS-026.says: Lightness keyed to 120 at frame 4, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
